english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an official or informational document.
Use this when “paperwork” means the written documents or forms themselves rather than the work of handling them.
Use this for a computer file understood specifically as a document, rather than arbitrary stored data.

examples.english: You need to submit this document to the company before you can register.
examples.traditional: 呢份文件要交畀公司先可以報名。
